main.description: One extra dock button on a wiki, beyond the wiki's navbarLinks. Two shapes: a linked button (buttonRef set) stays live from the creator's wiki.pckt.dockButton record, so the creator's art and label updates flow through; a forked button (label + href + art set) is a copy whose art lives in this wiki's repo and whose destination can be edited freely.

wikiRef.description: AT-URI of the wiki showing this button.

buttonRef.description: Linked shape: AT-URI of the shared wiki.pckt.dockButton record.

label.description: Forked shape: the button label shown under the bubble.

href.description: Forked shape: where the button leads — a wiki path like /@handle/wiki/slug or an absolute URL.

art.description: Forked shape: the bubble art, held in this wiki's repo.

createdAt.description: When the button was added to the wiki.
